evidence_quotes.quote: Reforming water sector governance and institutions for improving efficiency: the case of Mumbai
Programme Manager, Bombay First (Bombay City Policy Research Foundation)
In India, the progress of the urban water supply sector has been very slow because of improper focus and inadequate reforms in the urban local bodies.
